summary: Most iteration-0 problems are fixed: the sideways foot skate is gone (foot centre x moves 0.02 studs instead of 0.30), the feet no longer sink (lowest z -0.005..+0.015, 0 penetration frames), the legs alternate a deeper off-leg bend, the chest now counters the hips, the elbows work and the overlap score is 1.0. The loop seam is still clean (F063 -> F064/F000 continuous on every curve, speeds match the other beats). One problem remains, and my 1.4x knee scale made it worse: the planted feet now skate forward and back about 0.14-0.15 studs on every beat. Foot.rx is still mirror-identical left/right (the one remaining twinned channel), which is harmless for flat planted feet.

findings.observation: Side view, F000 vs F008 vs F016 (and every beat after): both feet shift forward on each down-beat and back on each up-beat while staying on the floor. Measured in the iter_1 blend, foot centre moves from y -0.168 at F008/F024 to -0.304 (weighted leg) and -0.318 (off leg) at F000/F016/F032: 0.14-0.15 studs every 8 frames (it was 0.10 in iteration 0; metrics still show mean_speed 0.018 studs/frame in a single 0-64 contact segment). Cause: thigh -28 / knee 49 puts the ankle 0.9*sin(28) - 0.75*sin(21) = 0.15 studs ahead of the hip. Fix: keep the knee bend but share it so the ankle stays under the hip (0.9*sin(thigh) = 0.75*sin(knee - thigh)): thighs x0.79 (-28 -> -22, -33.6 -> -26.5, -7 -> -5.5) and feet x1.29 (-21 -> -27, -7 -> -9) so the weighted foot stays flat and the off foot keeps its 5-degree toe roll; then re-plant, since the legs get about 0.02 studs shorter at the bottom of the bounce.
